title: Style-Locked Asset Generation Orchestrator
objective: Provide provider-neutral, deterministic style-locked asset-generation job preparation over governed art-bible/style/reference manifests while preserving owning content/ARI authority, cost and routing controls, and keeping generated assets as candidates until owning workflows accept them.

scope.purpose: Prepare provider-neutral style-locked asset-generation jobs without allowing any generation engine or provider to become canonical source authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative governed style/reference inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable provider-neutral generation jobs with stable cache/provenance and bounded routing/budget/review behavior while generated outputs remain candidate assets until owning workflows accept them and invalid owner/reference/provider/budget states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue on 2026-09-16 governed-started PCA-09; implementation authority is limited to work/pca-09-style-locked-asset-generation-orchestrator.
PCA-01..08 remain completed foundations and must be composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.

No separate canonical art-bible/style registry was found in the application repository under the deferred guessed names; PCA-09 must bind to existing governed resource/reference and PCA recipe contracts rather than invent parallel source authority.
PCA-01 retains recipe/provider/provenance preparation authority; PCA-04 and other owner-domain production contracts retain their specialized derivative preparation authority.
ARI retains resource identity, derivative lineage, rights/use and acceptance paths; generated outputs remain candidates until owning workflows accept them.

Optional generation providers/engines remain replaceable executors only. PCA-09 authorizes no credentials, network execution, paid-service operation, procurement, public upload, publication or canonical mutation.
PCA-10+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: Load only PCA-01/PCA-04 plus direct ARI resource/rights and provider-routing seams; establish causal PCA-09 RED, then implement the minimum deterministic style-locked generation-job preparation contract.
